evidence.description: test_dispatcher_invokes_mirror_in_process covers PROP-M2-dispatcher-invokes: menu with category=='settle-mirror' → asserts tasks/ untouched, build_log outcome contains 'settle-mirror:new=', settle.jsonl gains row with pass_id matching earnings row.

test_full_pipeline_matched_pass_id_updates_roi covers PROP-integration-full-loop: seeds earnings.jsonl with pass_id='p-42' + roi row, runs dispatcher tick 1 (mirror menu) then swaps to reconciler menu for tick 2, asserts roi_jpy_realized==3000.

test_full_pipeline_sentinel_path_creates_unmatched_entry covers PROP-integration-sentinel-path: earnings row WITHOUT pass_id → asserts settle row pass_id='unmatched-requestId-8888' after tick 1, then reconciler tick 2 → asserts .unmatched.jsonl row with reason=='unknown-pass-id' and matching sentinel pass_id.

test_dispatcher_earnings_path_uses_gig_dir_for_gig_slot asserts dispatcher derives ~/gig/earnings.jsonl from slot='gig' — a rename of slot or wrong Path.home()/slot join would produce no settle row, failing the assert. Guard against earnings_path drift satisfied.
test_dispatcher_source_has_settle_mirror_elif_branch grep-guards the elif branch string, _mirror_slot call, and outcome format literal — catches accidental branch removal or string drift.

Dispatcher STEP 6 elif branch invokes _mirror_slot(slot_dir, Path.home()/slot/'earnings.jsonl', now_ts) in-process; outcome format 'settle-mirror:new=X/dup=Y/unmatched=Z' matches integration test assertion. No tasks/ enqueue on this branch.
Reconciler routes rows with a sentinel pass_id (fails pass_id lookup) to .unmatched.jsonl with reason='unknown-pass-id' — matches sentinel-path test expectation exactly.
extract_pass_id_or_sentinel returns f'unmatched-requestId-{requestId}' — matches integration test expected value 'unmatched-requestId-8888'.

Single _run_dispatch subprocess helper with ANICCA_HAS_SESSION + lock/pass-mtime env vars; tests share _menu_with / _mirror_item / _reconciler_item / _roi_row factories — no duplication, no hidden global state.
REPO_ROOT / DISPATCH_PY / SHARED_DIR resolved via __file__ parents[3] — path-agnostic, no CI/local drift.
